cases.purpose: Checks that a small model can handle the very common short Telegram liveness turn without tools or filler.
cases.system_prompt: Reply in Russian unless the user writes in another language. Be concise and practical.

cases.purpose: Checks concise operational advice for a real admin/debug pattern.
limitations: Does not prove the model can inspect logs itself.
cases.system_prompt: Reply in Russian. Give the next action first. Do not use tools.
cases.prompt: Бот не отвечает. Что первым проверить?

cases.purpose: Checks admin/model-catalog diagnosis without brittle English-only wording.
limitations: Does not query the real database.
cases.system_prompt: Act as a pragmatic senior engineer. Give the next diagnostic step first.
cases.prompt: После деплоя админка открывается, но список моделей пустой. Что проверишь первым?

cases.purpose: Checks that deployment advice includes service state, health endpoint, and logs instead of only reporting CI success.
cases.system_prompt: Reply in Russian. Be concrete and operational.
cases.prompt: CI прошел, давай деплоить. Какие проверки после docker compose up обязательны?

cases.purpose: Checks calendar lookup routing with fixed dates, avoiding ambiguous relative-date behavior.
limitations: Only validates tool selection and top-level arguments; it does not execute a real calendar read.
cases.system_prompt: Use tools for calendar data. Use the exact ISO date range requested by the user.
cases.prompt: Посмотри мой календарь 2026-06-17 утром с 09:00 до 12:00 по Белграду и скажи, есть ли окно на 30 минут.

tools.name: calendar__get_events
tools.description: List calendar events for an exact date-time range.

cases.purpose: Checks task-list routing for short daily-planning prompts seen in production.
limitations: Only validates tool call shape, not task ranking quality.
cases.system_prompt: Use tools when the user asks about their tasks. Keep tool arguments minimal and explicit.

tools.name: tasks__get_tasks
tools.description: Get Todoist tasks for a date or project.

cases.purpose: Checks personal-memory recall for short 'check memory' style prompts.
limitations: Does not validate the factual answer after memory retrieval.
cases.system_prompt: Use personal memory tools when the user asks what you remember.
cases.prompt: Проверь память: что я сохранял про измерение продуктивности разработчиков?

tools.name: personal-memory__recall_facts
tools.description: Recall saved user facts by semantic query.

cases.purpose: Checks health-dashboard routing for the recurring sleep/health questions in production.
limitations: Does not judge medical correctness; it only checks that private health data is fetched through the tool.
cases.system_prompt: Use health-dashboard tools for the user's health data. Do not infer medical causes from tool-free context.

tools.name: health-dashboard__get_sleep_summary
tools.description: Get a sleep summary for a specific date.

cases.purpose: Checks file/document lookup routing for short prompts about remembered documents.
limitations: Does not validate filesystem permissions or final document content.
cases.system_prompt: Use filesystem search when the user asks to find something in their documents.
cases.prompt: Посмотри в документах, где была заметка про Тулу.

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Search files under the assistant context root.

cases.purpose: Checks web-search routing for freshness/prooflink prompts seen in news conversations.
limitations: Does not validate final source quality.
cases.system_prompt: Use web search for current events and proof links. Do not invent sources.
cases.prompt: А что в Белграде произошло 2026-05-01? Дай пруфлинки.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current or source-backed information.

cases.purpose: Checks model-selection reasoning without fabricated benchmark numbers.
limitations: Does not prove the recommendation is globally optimal.
cases.system_prompt: Reply in Russian. Be explicit about uncertainty. Do not fabricate benchmark numbers.
cases.prompt: Стоит ли полностью исключить free модели из роутинга, если часть из них внезапно становится платной или недоступной?

cases.purpose: Checks that compaction preserves decisions, unresolved tasks, and caveats from a long working session.
limitations: Does not test semantic clustering over real stored embeddings.
cases.system_prompt: Summarize the conversation state for future turns. Preserve decisions, unresolved tasks, concrete identifiers, and safety caveats.
cases.prompt: Сожми историю: PR #19 задеплоен; evals/workload.json теперь попадает в Docker image; бесплатные модели можно проверять вручную; paid eval только после подтверждения; нужно заменить синтетические evals на role-based suite из продовых паттернов; здоровье нельзя интерпретировать как диагноз без caveat.

cases.purpose: Checks that a model does not hallucinate screenshot contents when no image is attached.
limitations: Actual image understanding requires a later multimodal eval runner.
cases.system_prompt: Reply in Russian. If an image is not provided, do not claim to see it.
cases.prompt: Посмотри фотку предыдущую и скажи, что на ней не так.
